name: 提示词安全盾
description: 从 SkillScan/Shield CN 思路改造的提示词安全模块，面向中文场景检查 prompt 注入、凭证泄露、外发数据和危险动作。
description_en: Prompt security module adapted from SkillScan and Shield CN ideas. Checks prompt injection, credential leaks, data exfiltration, and dangerous actions with Chinese scenarios in mind.

apis.name: scanPrompt
apis.desc: 扫描用户提示词、系统提示词或任务配置，返回风险等级和命中项
apis.desc_en: Scan a user prompt, system prompt, or task config and return risk level plus findings

apis.name: redactSecrets
apis.desc: 对文本中的 API Key、Token、手机号、邮箱等敏感信息做脱敏
apis.desc_en: Redact API keys, tokens, phone numbers, emails, and other sensitive values

apis.name: openPage
apis.desc: 打开提示词安全盾界面并返回 _openModule 信号
apis.desc_en: Open Prompt Shield UI and return _openModule signal
